import requests
import json
import base64
import os
from urllib.parse import urlencode

# Auth0 configuration
AUTH0_DOMAIN = 'your-auth0-domain.auth0.com'
CLIENT_ID = 'your-client-id'
CLIENT_SECRET = 'your-client-secret'
REDIRECT_URI = 'http://localhost:3000/callback'

# PKCE code verifier and challenge
code_verifier = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(os.urandom(30)).decode('utf-8')
code_challenge = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hashlib.sha256(code_verifier.encode('utf-8')).digest()).decode('utf-8')

# Authorization URL
authorization_url = f'https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/authorize?{urlencode({
    'response_type': 'code',
    'client_id': CLIENT_ID,
    'redirect_uri': REDIRECT_URI,
    'code_challenge': code_challenge,
    'code_challenge_method': 'S256'
})}'

print(f'Authorization URL: {authorization_url}')

# User should visit the authorization URL and authorize the application
# After authorization, the user will be redirected to the REDIRECT_URI with a code

# Exchange authorization code for tokens
def exchange_code_for_tokens(code):
    token_url = f'https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}/oauth/token'
    token_payload = {
        'grant_type': 'authorization_code',
        'client_id': CLIENT_ID,
        'client_secret': CLIENT_SECRET,
        'code': code,
        'redirect_uri': REDIRECT_URI,
        'code_verifier': code_verifier
    }
    response = requests.post(token_url, data=token_payload)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()

import os
import flask
from google_auth_oauthlib.flow import Flow

app = flask.Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/oauth2callback')
def oauth2callback():
    flow = Flow.from_client_secrets_file(
        'client_secrets.json',
        scopes=['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.profile',
                'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email'])
    flow.redirect_uri = flask.url_for('oauth2callback', _external=True)

    authorization_response = flask.request.url
    flow.fetch_token(authorization_response=authorization_response)

    credentials = flow.credentials

    return 'Tokens exchanged successfully'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run()

import os
import requests

# Google OAuth2 configuration
CLIENT_ID = os.getenv('GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID')
CLIENT_SECRET = os.getenv('GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET')
REDIRECT_URI = 'http://localhost:8000/'

# Authorization endpoint
AUTHORIZATION_ENDPOINT = 'https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth'

# Scopes
SCOPES = ['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.profile', 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email']

def generate_authorization_url():
    params = {
        'client_id': CLIENT_ID,
        'redirect_uri': REDIRECT_URI,
        'response_type': 'code',
        'scope': ' '.join(SCOPES),
        'access_type': 'offline',
        'include_granted_scopes': 'true'
    }
    authorization_url = f"{AUTHORIZATION_ENDPOINT}?{urllib.parse.urlencode(params)}"
    return authorization_url

if __name__ == '__main__':
    if not CLIENT_ID or not CLIENT_SECRET:
        raise ValueError('GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET must be set in the environment variables')
    authorization_url = generate_authorization_url()
    print(f'Visit the following URL to authorize the application: {authorization_url}')
